ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram is titled "The Soil Food Web." It shows plants, organic matter, fungi, bacteria, protozoa, several groups of nematodes, arthropods, birds, and animals connected by arrows. Nematodes appear in multiple places, including "Nematodes Root-feeders," "Nematodes Fungal- and bacterial-feeders," and "Nematodes Predators." Some arrows connect nematodes toward larger organisms such as arthropods/predators. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows show energy or food moving from the organism being eaten to the organism that eats it. Since nematodes are shown as food for other organisms, their role in this relationship is prey.
